name: drama-club
description: Plan productions as boards of cards: cast, locations, props, shots, scenes and episodes. Built on mobile-nodemap.

scripts.dev: npm run db:local && (node scripts/build-client.mjs --watch & wrangler dev)
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/ensure-d1.mjs && wrangler d1 migrations apply dramaclub --remote && wrangler deploy
